## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what this change makes happen.

## Scope

Identify affected skills/agents, recorder code, contracts, adapters or documentation. Explain any changed approval/privacy assumptions and generated files.

## Validation

List relevant checks actually run and their results. State skipped checks and limitations. Use synthetic or redacted evidence only.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Source changes and generated references/adapters/checksums are consistent.
- [ ] Dedicated-browser, combined-review and approval/evidence rules remain intact, or a deliberate change is explained.
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, browser profiles or unredacted production logs are included.
- [ ] Licensing/third-party notices and relevant documentation are updated where needed.
